title: Uka Confianza Jawiraru Confiado
intro: Mä almax mä jan lurañjamäki uka kamachimpiw uñjasïna, ukanxa jichhak yurir wawax balanzaruw warktʼasïna. Diosan amuytʼayataw irpata, mä jan chʼamani kamachi istʼasïna, ukat mä wali valorani imantat yatiyäwiw uma jalsur jaqontäna, ukat jan amuytʼasisaw kuttʼayasïna.
clues: Mä tirano chachan chʼamapanwa jakasiyäta, jupajj jichhak nasit chachanakar jiwayapjjañapatakiw mayïna.
Mä divin inspiración ukaw nayarux purinitu, mä jan ch’amampi ukat chuyma ch’allxtayiri acción lurañatakiw yatichawayitu.
Wali valorani wawajarojj mä pechoruw uchayäta ukat jawir jawir patjjaruw uchayäta.
Chuymajax ch’usaruw tukuwayxäna, ukat niyaw imantat yatiyäw uñt’ayawayta, ukampis Allah jupax amtäwijaruw ch’amanchawayitu.
Nayax khitirus khithawayta, wawax jawir alayaruw saratapar arktañapataki, kunatix umax pecho ukarux apasxänwa.
Uka wawarux tirano utankirinakaw jikxatapxäna, ukat qhiparux, wawajampiw wasitat jikisipxta ukat enfermeraruw tukxarakta.

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Wawaparux mä pechoruw uchatayna ukat jawir patxaruw uchatayna
Jupax wawaparux mä mezquitan punkuparuw jaytawayi
trial.answer: Wawaparux mä pechoruw uchatayna ukat jawir patxaruw uchatayna

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Mä thujru ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Alaxpachat jutir manq’anakamp ch’allt’at mä mesa
Mä camello warmiw mä chimpunakjam khithatäna

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Jupajj wawapampiw mayamp jikisipjjäna ukat ñuñuyarakïna
Juparojj uka tirano sat jaqew jiwayäna
Jupajj Egipto markan mä reinaruw tuküna
Jupajj yaqha oraqeruw sarjjäna, ukat yaqha markar apanukusaw jakasïna
outcome.answer: Jupajj wawapampiw mayamp jikisipjjäna ukat ñuñuyarakïna

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
